name: inb
description: The inb function performs a low-level input operation to read a byte from the specified I/O port. It is primarily designed for internal kernel use but can be accessed from user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port number to read from

return_value.success: Returns the unsigned char value read from the port
return_value.failure: May result in a segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set

bugs: These functions require compilation with optimization enabled (-O or -O2 or similar), otherwise they are defined as inline macros and may cause unresolved references at link time.
